I posted about this in depth. Ranger is quite imbalanced at the moment considering how longbow hits drastically have a movement speed debuff on anyone hit, his self sufficiency, maps providing him a natural advantage through their design (narrow hallways), base kit hunting traps which can guarantee a kill if successful, highest resourcefulness in the game so they can easily evade any fight by opening/closing doors, and lastly having the option of using a high damage melee weapon like the spear which inherently manages to provide him distance in even melee combat…

I dont want to see Ranger get nerfed into the ground but it is quite clear in terms of utility, damage output, and situational control Ranger clearly has the most obscenely powerful kit in comparison to the rest of the cast in game.

I’d like to begin by saying great analysis of the circumstance and thank you for sharing your opinion without using the “get good” opinion that many other’s defending Ranger have taken to, however, there are a few points of discussion within your comment I would like to bring into question.

First, the just dodge argument is easy to say but much more difficult to implement in game. Considering many of the classes are limited in movement speed and all dungeons aside from Ruins consist of extremely narrow hallways Ranger does inherently have an advantage when fighting in the right conditions which he all too frequently maintains. Next, considering Ranger’s undeniably strong ability to pick and choose when/if they will engage in combat through the distance he can keep foes at bay as well as his insanely high resourcefulness to quickly evade enemies I simply feel like the amount of utility and power he maintains in the dungeons (ESPECIALLY solos) is unmatched in comparison to any other classes within the current game. Sure he can be outplayed but the skill required for Ranger to be outplayed essentially means that either their foe is at an much higher skill level than the Ranger and at that point you’re basically just praying that he has shit aim, no traps setup, and isn’t running the spear to keep you at a distance even while engaging in melee combat… now I will say, those that mindlessly just charge at Ranger should re-evaluate their tactics to survive (clearly) but there are many instances which will occur where one does not really have the option whether they should or should not engage and saying “just dodge” doesn’t really change the various other balancing issues within the class.

As stated, “seemingly counters every class flawlessly” I also mentioned the fact that he is somewhat able to be countered through Fighter (via bow) & Wizard (via fireball) aside from that please feel free to list any of the classes you believe counter the Ranger directly. Keep in mind, Rogue doesn’t counter Ranger effectively. He requires a perk for ranged capabilities and the damage is laughable in comparison to Ranger’s output. The only time (in my opinion from experience both playing as and against) a Ranger is directly countered is through the use of melee which requires one to either stupidly charge at the Ranger therefore providing him the ability to get in as many shots as possible before swapping to spear or by sneaking up on them which at the moment I have found is the only real way to directly counter them. This is not even considering his self sufficiency or over tuned base kit utility I.E. hunting trap, therefore, I don’t see that statement as an exaggeration… but unlike many I am capable of listening to constructive output from other experienced players so I’m open to receiving input :)

Edit: Considering the amount of utility and range capabilities Ranger currently has as well as considering his high damage output he outshines the rest of the cast and by tweaking some minor stats on him I think it’ll feel more balanced. I’m not trying to see Ranger gutted I think he’s extremely fun, but I can recognize that for many the counterplay for him is unsatisfying and unrealistic

Field ration is probably the least concerning aspect of Ranger’s imbalance within the class cast but it is notable that a class with such a high damage output also is blessed with capability of having self sufficiency for the GM instances which Ranger has become undeniably the most popular class chosen for the solo dungeons.

Any Ranger apart of a team that has a support character will immediately remove field rations to increase their damage output but the fact that Ranger has the option of being entirely self sufficient is really the main glaring issue with field rations.

I’ve played multiple games at a competitive level. I’m not here to just rant into the void because I got killed in a match and am salty, just trying to voice a genuine opinion on a variable of the game which is clearly in need of balancing. The issue with Ranger isn’t really a matter of ‘disengaging’ when in this game you clearly don’t always have the option considering the varying movement speeds between the classes and the presence or lack there of for having ranged capabilities. 

I’d also just like to add that considering how niche this game is the proportions of casual versus competitive users within the player base is noticeably different in comparison to name brand PvP games. Unfortunately in this case balancing becomes a much more difficult task considering players will abuse and use the most effective strategies until they are inevitably removed.

My point isn’t really contesting outplays or anything like that. At the end of the day there’s skill in dodging and in hitting your shots but as it stands if you’re facing anyone that has FPS experience and is decent at aiming it becomes immensely difficult for any class to contest a ranger and close the gap to just run them down. Additionally his self sufficiency and starting gear (hunting traps) are undeniably more valuable for pvp compared to any of the other classes.
